checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Both friends in one image, man left, woman right
Man retains beard, woman retains short blonde hair
must.why: Brown beard and blonde bob are kept.

must.item: Rendered as anime, not just filtered
must.why: Clean line art, cel shading and anime eyes.

summary: A clean anime version of the couple that keeps their positions, smiles, beard, blonde bob and beach; the only flaws are slight likeness drift and low resolution.
